lines.text: David summoned all the leaders of Israel to Jerusalem and told them he had wanted to build a house for the ark.
God told David he could not build the house because he was a man of war, and God chose Benjamin as leader.
God chose Solomon from David's many sons to build His house and promised to establish his kingdom forever if he obeyed.
David told Solomon to serve God wholeheartedly, because the LORD searches every heart, and to be strong and build the sanctuary.
David told Solomon that the plans came to him in writing from the LORD, copied from the old tabernacle plans.

wrong_details.wrong: copied from the old tabernacle plans
wrong_details.true: made clear to him in writing by the LORD
